en.headline: Shek Kwu Chau waste facility fire largely extinguished after four hours
en.dek: Firefighters brought the No. 3 alarm blaze at I·PARK1 under control by mid-afternoon, with about 930 people evacuated and one worker treated for discomfort.
body: Firefighters largely extinguished a No. 3 alarm fire at the Integrated Waste Management Facility Phase 1 on an artificial island off Shek Kwu Chau on Monday afternoon after it burned for about four hours.

The Hong Kong Observatory and police reports confirmed the blaze began at 12:43 pm and was upgraded to No. 3 at 1:24 pm. The Fire Services Department said the fire was surrounded at 3:47 pm, brought under control at 4:18 pm and largely put out by 4:45 pm. Crews used five hose lines and five breathing apparatus teams.

About 930 people evacuated themselves to safe areas, with many later taken by boat to Cheung Chau and Tsuen Wan public piers. One male staff member felt unwell after attempting to help and was taken by helicopter to Pamela Youde Nethersole Eastern Hospital. Police said they preliminarily believed construction materials stored in the building started the fire, which began on the roof and spread downward. The cause remains under investigation.
The facility, known as I·PARK1, is Hong Kong’s first large-scale waste-to-energy plant and began trial operations late last year.

zh.headline: 石鼓洲焚化設施三級火約四小時後大致救熄
zh.dek: 消防下午將I·PARK1三級火受控並大致救熄，約930人自行疏散，一人不適送院。
body: 石鼓洲旁人工島綜合廢物管理設施第一期周一發生的三級火，消防約四小時後大致救熄。
警方下午12時43分接獲報告，消防於下午1時24分將火警升為三級。消防處表示，火勢於下午3時47分受到包圍，下午4時18分受到控制，並於下午4時45分大致被救熄。消防員動用五條喉及五隊煙帽隊灌救。
約930人自行疏散到安全地方，其後多人乘船前往長洲及荃灣公眾碼頭。一名男職員試圖協助時感到不適，由直升機送往東區尤德夫人那打素醫院治理。警方初步相信建築物內儲存的建築材料首先起火，火勢由天台蔓延至低層，原因仍在調查。
涉事的I·PARK1是本港首座大型轉廢為能設施，去年底開始試行運作。
